items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I knew Venuti. Venuti sent me word just before he died to tell me hello.

ctx.x: They had that Venuti line quintet of the Hot Jazz Club of France.

Yeah. I knew Venuti. Venuti sent me word just before he died to tell me hello. Mm-hmm. Well, anyway. And I'll never forget Red Nichols. I met him out in California and sat in in his band. And he offered me a job that night. He asked me if I'd feel like settling out in Los Angeles. He said, if you settle out here, I'll give you a job immediately. I love the way you knock a band out. He said, you swing a band. You make a band play. That was very nice. It was a very nice thing for a man to say, especially Red…
Mm-hmm. And you went out in California, too, then.
